ordered_diagnoses: Giant cell tumor of the skull

facts.raw_span: A man in his mid-30s
forehead mass initially thought to be a lipoma
the lesion had appeared 1 year earlier after minor forehead trauma
had slowly enlarged over the past 4 months without pain or other symptoms
extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of the left foot treated 9 years earlier
below‐knee amputation and adjuvant ifosfamide–doxorubicin chemotherapy
a 10 cm × 8 cm soft, compressible mass on the right forehead
a gray, well‐circumscribed mass
a palpable bony step‐off at the base
Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a mass arising from the right frontal diploic space
with intracranial extension and possible involvement of the superior sagittal sinus
Noncontrast head CT revealed a lytic lesion of the right frontal bone with hypodense soft‐tissue extension into the scalp
